notes: This is al-Saduq's statement of his routes («طرق») to Bakr b. Muhammad al-Azdi, with no saying: needs ruling (rule 11). «عن بكر بن محمد الأزدي» is written once at the end, so it is the shared tail. «رضي الله عنه» is a blessing.
The «؛» separators do not say which route is whose: the three names after the Saffar are read as one level. Read this as a provisional reading, not a route for the saying.
